items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: Max and I on the strength of that, have been very good friends since.

ctx.x: Yes. I ran into Max. I had never seen him before nor had he ever seen me, but we had seen each other's pictures. And it was a cold February day in Chicago and I was playing the Blue Note, and I think Max was playing at the London House, and the wind was up about near the north side of so 45 miles an hour, Michigan Avenue, and we were both -- he was coming -- he was walking south and I was walking north going our different ways, of course, and we were really, you know, holding our coats, because it was terribly…
Max told me how much he admired Dave and how the ideas he got...
